Name: Realtime Minimap
Author: spacechase0
Description:
Adds a live minimap based on the in-game location, including players, NPCs, and signs with items on them. (By default it's cached when you enter the location, but you can enable full realtime if you prefer.)

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]For players[/size][/b]
The minimap is shown in the top-left corner by default. You can move it using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], and toggle it using the keybind ([font=Courier New]Ctrl[/font] + [font=Courier New]M[/font] by default).

Markers can be added to the map by placing Wood, Stone, or Dark Signs, and then placing an item on them. By default, markers from Dark Signs are slightly larger. Markers might be a little off-center on small maps; mainly meant for large farm maps.

Can be configured with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
